learning_notes.content: Graph RAG connects structured knowledge graphs with retrieval so agents can traverse entities and relations instead of relying only on flat chunk search. I plan to link Neo4j concepts to hybrid retrieval in the research lab.
BM25 plus dense embeddings fused with reciprocal rank fusion improves recall on technical notes and papers. Cross-encoder reranking sharpens precision for agent evidence bundles.
Agentic workflows benefit from MCP tools for external systems while keeping synthesis grounded in local evidence. I separate planning, collection, critique, and synthesis stages.
